verdict_reason: Malformed-JSON 400 and locked-contract camelCase drift are resolved, but the new OptimisticLockingFailureException 409 handler has no unit or IT coverage.

todos.issue: New handleOptimisticLocking (@ExceptionHandler OptimisticLockingFailureException → 409 conflict) has no unit test, unlike the sibling HttpMessageNotReadable handler added in the same delta; without coverage a regression can silently fall through the RuntimeException catch-all to 500.
todos.fix: Add a GlobalExceptionHandlerTest case asserting handleOptimisticLocking returns 409 application/problem+json with type .../conflict, fixed detail, camelCase traceId and no errors map.

todos.issue: New OptimisticLockingFailureException handler emits 409 conflict (type https://api.cdp.defra.cloud/problems/conflict) but docs/openapi/api-contract.locked.yaml declares no 409 on update-address (or delete-address), so concurrent @Version save conflicts are a live wire status absent from the locked contract.
todos.fix: Add a 409 Problem response to update-address (and any other mutating op that saves an @Version Address) in api-contract.locked.yaml, documenting the conflict problem type and detail.
